description: A function line profiling was aimed at, and the count that picked it: where the process's time went (its own time, weighted up by the slow clicks and ops it ran within).

function.description: What's profiled, as its count names it (module:Class.method).

count.description: Its runs in the stretch it was picked from (the last day).

seconds.description: Its own time added up in that stretch (the processor time it took, less its counted callees').

kind.description: A click (part, menu) or a wire op the host answered (op).

name.description: Its count's name ("Composer.region/send button", an op).

seconds.description: The function's own time within it.

each.description: Its average time, a click's or op's: what weighted the function up.

within.description: The click or op it ran within that weighted it most (none: it ran within none).
